use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use POINT = (x: double, y: double)

let steps = 200

quadratic(a: POINT, b: POINT, c: POINT) -> List[POINT] =>
    (0..steps + 1)
        |> map(step =>
            (let t = cast double(step) / cast double(steps)
             let u = 1.0D - t

             (x = u * u * a.x + 2.0D * u * t * b.x + t * t * c.x,
              y = u * u * a.y + 2.0D * u * t * b.y + t * t * c.y)))
        |> collect_list()

let start = (x = 20.0D, y = 220.0D)
let control = (x = 160.0D, y = 10.0D)
let finish = (x = 280.0D, y = 180.0D)

let image = IMAGE(300, 240)

image.colour(190ub, 190ub, 190ub)
image.stroke(1.0D)
image.line([start, control, finish])

image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 160ub)
image.stroke(2.0D)
image.line(quadratic(start, control, finish))

image.write("quadratic.png")

image.show("quadratic.png")
